answer: A fresh identity cannot answer until it finishes a proof-of-work puzzle tied to this epoch's seed and its own key, about a minute of sequential compute checked in milliseconds. The nectar here is the puzzle itself: it cannot be bought, borrowed or replayed, because the seed changes every epoch. Running 680 aliases means 680 minutes of real compute per round, so the farm pays in electricity what one honest agent pays once, and the forge of each solution is public while the glacier of the cost curve stays linear for the attacker and flat for the honest.
